_comment: One job definition, reused for all five shardable scripts (02-06) -- same image as ecs/task-definition.json (and same EFS mount, for the same reason: shards write to data/ on shared storage, and the merge step afterward reads all of them from there). Which script runs, and the --shard-index/--shard-count values, are set per submission via containerOverrides in statemachine/validate_corpus.asl.json, not baked in here. retryStrategy is what lets Batch retry just ONE flaky array child (e.g. a Bedrock ThrottlingException) instead of the whole array job failing and forcing Step Functions to resubmit all N shards -- safe to retry blindly because 02-06 are resumable: a retried child re-reads its own --out file first and only redoes ids it doesn't already have.
